description: This is a unit test class for the CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification in the application core specifications namespace. It tests the evaluation of the specification against a test collection of Order objects, verifying that the specification correctly filters and retrieves orders with their associated order items.

classes.name: CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification
classes.description: A unit test class that verifies the behavior of CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification, ensuring it correctly fetches orders with their items for a specific buyer.

methods.name: ReturnsOrderWithOrderedItem
methods.description: Test method to verify that the specification retrieves an order with its associated order items and verifies the presence of item details.

methods.name: ReturnsAllOrderWithAllOrderedItem
methods.description: Test method to verify that multiple orders with multiple items are correctly retrieved by the specification.

methods.name: GetTestCollection
methods.description: Provides a sample list of Order objects with associated OrderItems to test the specification's evaluation.
